source_claim: Nintendo's official Ocarina of Time product page identifies the title and its character roster. It describes Link as a boy beginning his quest and Princess Zelda as the young princess of Hyrule. These are the exact Ocarina of Time identities represented by current campaign tags young_link and young_zelda; the accepted Nintendo mapping resolves them to the stable Legend of Zelda HOME root.
notes: Only the two exact Ocarina of Time youth identities present in the current campaign are included. The HOME root is the accepted stable Zelda franchise root, not a second appearance-specific title home.
